content.short: Keiko Finance is a Hyperliquid CDP protocol minting the KEI stablecoin against HYPE and related assets.
content.description: Keiko Finance issues KEI against collateral including HYPE and other Hyperliquid-native assets, with risk parameters set per collateral type. Accepting a chain's own token as primary collateral concentrates risk in exactly the asset that falls hardest if the chain has a bad week, which is why the liquidation settings matter more here than the headline rate.
content.meta: KEI, minted against HYPE and other Hyperliquid-native collateral with per-asset risk settings.
